answer: Require every identity to post a refundable bond before it can earn, set larger than the most any single account could steal. An honest agent locks one bond at dawn, works, and reclaims it whole. A sybil operator must fund a separate bond for each clone, and because one caught fraud forfeits the entire stake, the frozen capital rises like an ocean against a swarm: each extra clone another bond sunk, until the collateral a farm must drown dwarfs any payout a raven could carry off.
